## Automated Tests Required

### S3-05: StatusEffectsManager (StatusEffects system)

**Unit test file**: `tests/unit/status-effects/status_effects_manager_test.gd`
**Integration test file**: `tests/integration/status-effects/status_effects_integration_test.gd`
**GDD**: `design/gdd/status-effects.md`
**Estimated test count**: ~27 unit + ~5 integration = ~32 total
**FP scope**: Burn + Freeze + Regen fully wired. Blind + Stun + Chill + Stagger as structured stubs
(instance created, signals emitted, duration tracked, no tick logic for stubs).

**Test harness**: Use mock/double for `HealthDamage` and enemy nodes. Drive `_process(delta)` manually via
`_process(0.016)` loops to advance float accumulators.

**What to test — Unit:**

*Burn — apply and tick (AC-SE-01 through AC-SE-04):*
- `apply_status(enemy, BURN, 2.0, 20.0)` → one StatusInstance in `_active_statuses` with
  `duration_remaining ≈ 2.0s`; `status_applied(enemy, BURN, 2.0)` emitted once (AC-SE-01)
- After 0.5s via `_process` accumulation: `HealthDamage.apply_damage(enemy, 1.6, null, DOT)` called once
  — Formula 1: `max(0, 20.0) × 0.08 = 1.6`; assert value passed to H&D, not H&D's rounded output (AC-SE-02)
- Burn expiry: instance removed from registry; `status_expired(enemy, BURN)` emitted once; no tick fires
  after expiry (AC-SE-03)
- Burn re-apply: `apply_status(enemy, BURN, 2.0, 30.0)` on enemy with 1.0s remaining at `spell_base_damage=20.0`
  → `duration_remaining ≈ 2.0s` reset; `spell_base_damage = 30.0`; exactly one StatusInstance; `status_applied`
  emitted once (AC-SE-04)

*Freeze — apply, lock, expiry (AC-SE-05 through AC-SE-07):*
- `apply_status(drifter, FREEZE, 2.0, 0.0)` → `drifter.apply_speed_modifier(0.50)` called exactly once;
  `has_status(drifter, FREEZE)` returns `true` (AC-SE-05)
- Freeze expiry (duration reaches 0): `drifter.apply_speed_modifier(1.0)` called;
  `has_status(drifter, FREEZE)` returns `false` (AC-SE-06)
- Freeze re-apply while already active: `apply_speed_modifier` NOT called a second time (no-op);
  `duration_remaining ≈ 2.0s` reset; exactly one instance (AC-SE-07)

*Regen — apply and tick (AC-SE-08, AC-SE-21):*
- `apply_status(fayde, REGENERATE, 3.0, 0.0)` → after 1.0s: `HealthDamage.apply_heal(fayde, 2.0)` called once
  — Formula 2: `100 × 0.02 = 2.0` (AC-SE-08)
- After 3.0s total: `apply_heal` called exactly 3 times; Fayde gains 6 HP total (AC-SE-21)

*Target scope guard (AC-SE-09, AC-SE-10):*
- `apply_status(fayde, BURN, 2.0, 20.0)` → no StatusInstance; error logged; `status_applied` NOT emitted (AC-SE-09)
- `apply_status(enemy, REGENERATE, 3.0, 0.0)` → no StatusInstance; error logged; `status_applied` NOT emitted (AC-SE-10)

*Dead target guard (AC-SE-11):*
- `apply_status` on enemy with `current_hp=0` (mock `is_alive()` returns false) → no instance; no signal (AC-SE-11)

*Kill cleanup (AC-SE-12):*
- Enemy with active Burn AND active Freeze; `HealthDamage.enemy_killed` fires → both instances removed;
  `apply_speed_modifier(1.0)` called on enemy (Freeze cleanup); no further tick calls for that enemy (AC-SE-12)

*Burn Contagion (AC-SE-13 through AC-SE-15):*
- Burning enemy dies; second enemy within 200px: `apply_status(second_enemy, BURN, 2.0, original_base)` called;
  `burn_contagion_triggered(dying_pos, second_enemy)` emitted once (AC-SE-13)
- Burning enemy dies; no other enemy within 200px: no transfer; `burn_contagion_triggered` NOT emitted (AC-SE-14)
- Second enemy at exactly 201px: Contagion does NOT transfer — boundary check (AC-SE-15)

*Shatter — Formula 4 (AC-SE-16 through AC-SE-18):*
- `check_and_apply_shatter(frozen_enemy, 16.0)` returns `20.0` (`16.0 × 1.25`);
  `shatter_triggered(enemy)` emitted once (AC-SE-16)
- Enemy without active Freeze: returns `16.0` unchanged; `shatter_triggered` NOT emitted (AC-SE-17)
- Frozen enemy, `check_and_apply_shatter` called twice same frame: both return `1.25×` value;
  Freeze NOT consumed (Shatter is non-consuming; AC-SE-18)

*Phase/wave clear (AC-SE-19):*
- Enemies with active Burn and Freeze; `preparation_started` fires → `_active_statuses` empty;
  `apply_speed_modifier(1.0)` called on Frozen enemy; no tick fires after clear (AC-SE-19)

*Zero-duration guard (AC-SE-20):*
- `apply_status(enemy, BURN, 0.0, 20.0)` → no StatusInstance created; error logged (AC-SE-20)

*Stub effects — Blind, Stun, Chill, Stagger (AC-SE-22 through AC-SE-27):*
- Blind: StatusInstance created; `status_applied(enemy, BLIND, 2.0)` emitted; no tick logic fires;
  after 2.0s `status_expired(enemy, BLIND)` emitted; instance removed (AC-SE-22)
- Stun: `enemy.apply_stun(0.8)` called exactly once at apply; after 0.8s `status_expired(enemy, STUN)` emitted;
  no second method call on expiry (self-terminating in Enemy AI; AC-SE-23)
- Chill suppressed by Freeze: enemy with active FREEZE + `apply_status(enemy, CHILL, ...)` → no CHILL instance;
  `apply_speed_modifier` NOT called second time; `status_applied` NOT emitted for CHILL (AC-SE-24)
- Chill without Freeze: CHILL instance created; `enemy.apply_speed_modifier(0.85)` called (`1.0 − 0.15`);
  `status_applied(enemy, CHILL, 2.0)` emitted (AC-SE-25)
- Chill expiry: `enemy.apply_speed_modifier(1.0)` called; `has_status(enemy, CHILL)` returns `false` (AC-SE-26)
- Stagger: `enemy.apply_stun(0.3)` called once at apply; `status_applied(enemy, STAGGER, 0.3)` emitted;
  after 0.3s `status_expired(enemy, STAGGER)` emitted; no second method call on expiry (AC-SE-27)

**Edge cases to cover (from GDD Edge Cases section):**
- `spell_base_damage = 0.0`: `max(0, 0.0) × 0.08 = 0.0` — Burn tick calls H&D with 0; no negative DoT
- Burn re-apply at tick 3 (only 1 tick remaining): `duration_remaining` reset to 2.0s; `spell_base_damage` updated;
  tick count restarts at 4 from new base
- Freeze already active on re-apply: `apply_speed_modifier` is a no-op; single instance in registry
- `preparation_started` mid-tick-accumulator: instances cleared before tick loop processes them; cleared
  instances absent from registry — loop skips silently
- `apply_status` with `duration <= 0`: error logged; no instance created

**Integration test scope:**
- StatusEffectsManager + real HealthDamage Autoload: Burn tick calls `apply_damage` → HP actually decrements
- StatusEffectsManager + real GameStateManager Autoload: `preparation_started` signal clears all instances
- Enemy node with real `apply_speed_modifier` and `apply_stun` methods: Freeze slow confirmed on enemy movement

*No formula found for Burn Contagion range check — range is a distance comparison, not a formula.
Test must use specific positions (200px = transfer; 201px = no transfer) per GDD Edge Case 5 formula.*

### S3-07: WaveManager

**Integration test file**: `tests/integration/wave-encounter-system/wave_manager_integration_test.gd`
**GDD**: `design/gdd/wave-encounter-system.md`
**Estimated test count**: ~15 integration tests

**What to test:**

*Wave composition constants (AC-WES-01 through AC-WES-03):*
- `FP_DRIFTER_COUNT=3`, `FP_CHARGER_COUNT=2`, `FP_CLUSTER_COUNT=5`; sum = 10 (AC-WES-01)
- All `enemy_type_id` values in FP composition exist in EnemyCatalog with `status=active`
  and non-null `wave_threat_value` (AC-WES-02)
- Threat budget calculation: `(3×1) + (2×2) + (5×1) = 12` — Formula 1 (AC-WES-03)
  - Note: GDD corrected Charger threat value to 2 (Ice/Deepfrost, gap-closer); Cluster = 1. Verify formula
    matches `design/gdd/wave-encounter-system.md` Formula 1 table exactly.

*Spawn sequence (AC-WES-04 through AC-WES-06):*
- `combat_started(is_boss: false)` with ≥10 spawn markers in scene → 10 enemy nodes added to scene tree;
  `_enemies_alive=10`; `_enemies_total=10`; `_wave_state=WAVE_ACTIVE`; all 10 added same frame
  (no deferred `add_child`; AC-WES-04)
- Each spawned node receives `init(enemy_type_id)` → enemy's `_archetype`, `_base_damage`, `_move_speed`
  match EnemyCatalog definition for that `type_id` (delegates to Enemy AI AC-EAI-03a/b/c; AC-WES-05)
- Fewer spawn markers than composition count → `push_error()` logged; remaining enemies spawned up to
  marker count; `_enemies_total` equals actual spawn count (not composition count; AC-WES-06)

*Kill tracking (AC-WES-07, AC-WES-08):*
- `_wave_state=WAVE_ACTIVE`, `_enemies_alive=5`; `enemy_killed` fires once → `_enemies_alive=4`;
  `_wave_state` remains `WAVE_ACTIVE` (AC-WES-07)
- `_enemies_alive=1`; final `enemy_killed` fires → `_enemies_alive=0`; `_wave_state=WAVE_COMPLETE` (AC-WES-08)

*Wave completion signals (AC-WES-09 through AC-WES-11):*
- `_enemies_alive` reaches 0 → `all_waves_cleared` emitted exactly once AND `boss_defeated` emitted exactly
  once, sequential, same frame (same handler call; AC-WES-09)
- After `WAVE_COMPLETE` entered; subsequent `enemy_killed` fires → `_wave_state` remains `WAVE_COMPLETE`;
  neither signal re-emitted (AC-WES-10)
- `_enemies_total=0` after spawn loop (all spawns failed) → `push_error()` logged; `all_waves_cleared` +
  `boss_defeated` emitted; `_wave_state=WAVE_COMPLETE`; run does not softlock (AC-WES-11)

*Phase gating (AC-WES-12, AC-WES-13):*
- `combat_started(is_boss: true)` while `_wave_state=WAVE_ACTIVE` → no enemies spawned; state unchanged;
  debug warning logged (AC-WES-12)
- `preparation_started` after `WAVE_COMPLETE` → `_enemies_alive=0`; `_enemies_total=0`; `_wave_state=IDLE` (AC-WES-13)

*Full integration flow (AC-WES-14, AC-WES-15):*
- Complete FP sequence: `preparation_started` → `combat_started(false)` → 10×`enemy_killed` → `_enemies_alive=0`
  → `all_waves_cleared` ×1 → `boss_defeated` ×1 → `_wave_state=WAVE_COMPLETE` (AC-WES-14)
- Fayde dies mid-wave (`player_died` → GS&SF transitions to DEATH_SCREEN): neither `all_waves_cleared` nor
  `boss_defeated` emitted; `_wave_state` resets on next `preparation_started` (AC-WES-15)

**Edge cases to cover (from GDD Edge Cases section):**
- `_enemies_alive` goes negative (duplicate `enemy_killed` bug): `<= 0` guard still fires wave completion
- All spawn markers stacked at same position: enemies spawn on top of each other; Enemy AI degenerate-direction
  guard handles `dir.length() < 0.01` — enemies slide apart within first physics frame; no WaveManager intervention

### S3-08: SpellCastingEffects (FP scope)

**Unit test file**: `tests/unit/spell-casting-effects/spell_casting_effects_test.gd`
**Integration test file**: `tests/integration/spell-casting-effects/spell_casting_integration_test.gd`
**GDD**: `design/gdd/spell-casting-effects.md`
**Estimated test count**: ~24 unit + 1 integration + 2 manual = ~27 total
**FP scope**: Status effects are field-write stubs only (`target.status_freeze_timer`, etc.) — StatusEffectsManager
is implemented in S3-05 but SC&E does NOT call it at FP (wiring happens at MVP). Shatter (Step 5) inert at FP
(`check_and_apply_shatter` returns `raw_damage` unchanged — `has_status` returns false). Follow-Through (Step 6)
inert at FP (`_is_attacking` flag undefined in EnemyInstance at FP). Blind bonus (Step 7) inert at FP.

**Test harness**: Inject `_rng: RandomNumberGenerator` via `@export`; seed in `before_each()` for deterministic
crit and miss rolls. Drive float accumulators via `_process(1.0 / 60.0)` loops. Inject Audio System via `@export`
as a null stub to suppress audio calls.

**What to test — Unit:**

*State machine and lifecycle (AC-SC-01 through AC-SC-06):*
- IDLE → READY on `combo_resolved` with valid `primary_type` during COMBAT_PHASE:
  `_state == READY`; `_combo_index == 0` (AC-SC-01)
- Cast input rejected in IDLE state: `apply_damage` never called; `_combo_index` remains 0 (AC-SC-02)
- Cast input rejected when `_cast_lock_timer > 0`: no attack; `_combo_index` unchanged (AC-SC-03)
- `_combo_index` advances on successive casts within window: Deepfrost T3 (count=3), cast → lock expires
  via `_process(0.13)` → cast again → `_combo_index == 2` (AC-SC-04)
- Chain resets to READY when `combo_continuation_window` (2.0s) expires without cast: `_combo_index == 0`;
  `_state == READY` (AC-SC-05)
- `preparation_started` → IDLE; `_combo_index == 0`; `_current_spell_effect == null` (AC-SC-06)

*Cast lock durations (AC-SC-10):*
- Voidblue T1: `cast_hit_started` emits with `lock_duration == 0.12`
- Ashfire T1: `cast_hit_started` emits with `lock_duration == 0.20` (AC-SC-10)

*Follow-Through suppressed at FP (AC-SC-11):*
- Stormgold T2 index 1, `_followthrough_window = 0.0`, no stat bonuses, no status conditions:
  `apply_damage` called with `raw_damage = round(20 × 1.15 × 1.20) = 28` — no Step 6 ×1.30 bonus (AC-SC-11)

*Damage formulas (AC-SC-12 through AC-SC-18, AC-SC-19, AC-SC-25):*
- Formula 1: Ashfire T1 neutral → `apply_damage(raw_damage=25.0)` — `round(20 × 1.25 × 1.00) = 25` (AC-SC-12)
- Formula 3 Step 1 type branch (AC-SC-13):
  - primary_type=0 (Ashfire): `flat_stat_bonus = aggregate["ASH_DMG"] = 5.0`
  - primary_type=3 (Deepfrost): `flat_stat_bonus = aggregate["FROST_DMG"] = 3.0`
  - primary_type=2 (Stormgold): `flat_stat_bonus = 0.0` — no flat stat for Stormgold
  - All three sub-cases must pass; `or`-operator bug (reading ASH_DMG for all types) fails case (c)
- Formula 3 Step 5 — Shatter unit test (mock StatusEffectsManager returning `has_status=true`):
  Deepfrost T1 vs Frozen target → `apply_damage(round(20 × 0.80 × 1.00 × 1.25) = 20)` (AC-SC-14)
  *Note: at FP integration, Shatter is inert — this test requires a mock/double for StatusEffectsManager.*
- Formula 3 Step 9 — Elemental affiliation: Ashfire T1 vs fire-affiliated enemy →
  `apply_damage(round(25.0 × 2.0) = 50)` (AC-SC-15)
- Formula 4 — Stormgold T3 fork: `round(20 × 1.15 × 1.00 × 0.60) = 14`; fork target received;
  Steps 5–9 excluded from fork call (AC-SC-16)
- Formula 5 — ADJ_DOUBLE_HIT: Ashfire T1, Frozen target (mock);
  first firing: `raw_damage ≈ 31.25` (step-4 × Shatter); second firing: `raw_damage ≈ 18.75` (step-4 × 0.75 only;
  Shatter excluded from second firing; AC-SC-17)
- Formula 6 — ADJ_ECHO: fires at 0.8s (drive via `_process`); `round(20 × 1.25 × 0.50) = 13`;
  Steps 5–9 excluded; `_rng` seeded to never crit (AC-SC-18)
- Formula 7 FP stub defaults (AC-SC-19):
  - Deepfrost T1, empty `aggregate_stat_bonus` → `target.status_freeze_timer == 2.0`
  - Stormgold T1, empty bonuses → `target.status_stun_timer == 0.8`
- Formula 7 with stat bonuses (AC-SC-25):
  - `aggregate = {"FROST_FREEZE_DUR": 0.5}`, Deepfrost T1 → `target.status_freeze_timer == 2.5`
  - `aggregate = {"STORM_STUN_DUR": 0.4}`, Stormgold T1 → `target.status_stun_timer == 1.2`

*Edge cases (AC-SC-20 through AC-SC-24):*
- `tier_attack_modifier == 0.0` (Verdant T2 SELF; Deepfrost T3 glacial field): `apply_damage` never called;
  only secondary effect fires (barrier grant / glacial slow zone; AC-SC-20)
- `preparation_started` mid-chain cancels echo timer: `_echo_timer == 0.0`; `_state == IDLE` (AC-SC-21)
- ADJ_ECHO does not fire after `preparation_started` even when delay elapses (AC-SC-22)
- ASH_CRIT applies at `_combo_index == 0` only: guaranteed crit (`_rng.randf()` always returns 0.0),
  first attack includes ×1.50; second attack does NOT include ×1.50 (AC-SC-23)
- `combo_resolved` with `primary_type == -1` → `push_error` called; `_state` remains IDLE;
  subsequent cast produces no attack (AC-SC-24)

*Signal emission (AC-SC-26):*
- `spell_hit_element(target, primary_type_id)` emitted exactly once per hit; NOT emitted on miss (no target)
  — verify with GUT signal spy (AC-SC-26)

*No-target cast:*
- Cast fires; no collision in ray → `apply_damage` never called; `apply_status` never called;
  `_combo_index` advances normally; combo window starts (AC-SC-08)

**What to test — Manual [M] (physics scene required — run in Godot editor):**

*[M] AC-SC-07* — DIRECTIONAL_FACING ray selection:
- Fayde at (100,100) facing right; Enemy A at (180,100) (80px); Enemy B at (230,100) (130px);
  `CAST_MAX_RANGE=150px`. Voidblue T1 cast → `apply_damage` on Enemy A only; Enemy B receives no damage.

*[M] AC-SC-09* — Ashfire T3 AREA_AROUND_FAYDE origin:
- Fayde at (200,200); Enemy A at (240,200) (40px from Fayde); Enemy B at (320,200) (120px from Fayde;

### S3-09: CombatHUD (minimal)

**Unit test file**: `tests/unit/combat-hud/combat_hud_test.gd`
**GDD**: `design/gdd/combat-hud.md`
**Estimated test count**: ~22 unit + 4 manual = ~26 total

**What to test — Unit:**

*HP bar behavior (AC-HUD-01 through AC-HUD-03):*
- `damage_taken(fayde, 20, 80)` fires; `HP_BAR_DRAIN_DURATION` (0.15s) elapses via `_process` accumulation
  → `ProgressBar.value == 80` (AC-HUD-01)
- `assert HP_BAR_DRAIN_DURATION == 0.15` — constant guard in `_ready()`; prevents accidental tuning to 0 (AC-HUD-02a)
- `damage_taken(fayde, 20, 80)` fires → `hp_label.text == "80 / 100"` same frame (no tween on numeric; AC-HUD-03)

*HP zone color treatment (AC-HUD-04 through AC-HUD-06):*
- `player_hp_zone_changed(HPZone.CAREFUL)` → bar fill modulate == `Color("#FFA500")`; label color == `Color("#FFA500")` (AC-HUD-04)
- `player_hp_zone_changed(HPZone.DESPERATE)` → bar fill modulate == `Color("#FF3333")`; label color == `Color("#FF3333")` (AC-HUD-05)
- `player_hp_zone_changed(HPZone.FULL)` → bar fill modulate == `Color("#F5F0E8")`; label color == `Color("#FFFFFF")` (AC-HUD-06)

*Dead state (AC-HUD-07):*
- `player_died` fires (bar at 0/max); subsequent `damage_taken`, `health_restored`, `player_hp_zone_changed`
  each fire → `ProgressBar.value` remains 0; bar fill modulate does NOT change for any subsequent signal (AC-HUD-07)

*Heal tween and audio silence contract (AC-HUD-08, AC-HUD-09):*
- `health_restored(fayde, 6, 66)` → ProgressBar tweening toward 66 (value between 60–66 before tween completes);
  modulate == `Color(0.6, 1.0, 0.6, 1.0)` at tween start; after `HEAL_TINT_DURATION` (0.20s),
  modulate == current zone color (not green; AC-HUD-08)
- `assert HP_BAR_FILL_DURATION >= 0.15` — constant guard; verifies sfx_fayde_heal silence contract cannot
  be broken by tuning (AC-HUD-09)

*Chain dots (AC-HUD-10 through AC-HUD-12):*
- SC&E has SpellEffect with `primary_type=2` (Stormgold); `preparation_started` fired; `combat_started` fires;
  `chain_index_changed(0, 2)` fires → chain dots node visible; 2 dots drawn; dot[0] color == `Color("#FFCC00")`
  (Stormgold); dot[1] color == `Color("#888888")` (grey; AC-HUD-10)
- `chain_index_changed(1, 2)` fires with primary_type=0 (Ashfire) → dot[1] color == `Color("#F24C1D")`;
  dot[0] == `Color("#888888")` (AC-HUD-11)
- `preparation_started` fires → chain dots node NOT visible (AC-HUD-12)

*Damage labels — spawn and coloring (AC-HUD-13 through AC-HUD-19):*

  color == `Color("#FFFFFF")` (element signal for A not applied to B; AC-HUD-15)

- 5 Label nodes active (below cap=12); `damage_taken` fires → no existing label freed; count == 6 (AC-HUD-19)

*Run reset and tween edge cases (AC-HUD-20 through AC-HUD-23):*
- HP bar mid-drain-tween; `run_started` fires → `ProgressBar.value == FAYDE_MAX_HP` (100) immediately;

### S3-10: RunManager

**Unit test file**: `tests/unit/run-management/run_manager_test.gd`
**Integration test file**: `tests/integration/run-management/run_manager_integration_test.gd`
**GDD**: `design/gdd/run-management.md`
**Estimated test count**: ~13 unit + 1 integration + 1 manual smoke = ~15 total

**What to test — Unit:**

*Signal handlers — run lifecycle (AC-RM-01 through AC-RM-08):*
- `run_started` → `run_active=true`; `run_outcome=NONE`; `waves_completed=0` (AC-RM-01)
- `run_started` while `run_active=true` → all fields reset; `push_error` called with `"[RunManager]"` in message
  (verify via GUT error watcher; AC-RM-02)
- `wave_ended` fires ×3 → `waves_completed=3`; `get_run_data()["waves_completed"] == 3` (AC-RM-03)
- `room_cleared` fires → `run_outcome=WIN`; `run_active` remains `true`; second `room_cleared` is idempotent
  (`run_outcome` stays WIN, no error; AC-RM-04)
- `run_ended(true)` after `room_cleared` → `run_active=false`; `run_outcome=WIN` (AC-RM-05)
- `run_ended(false)` with `run_outcome=NONE` (no `room_cleared`) → `run_active=false`; `run_outcome=LOSS` (AC-RM-06)
- `run_ended(false)` after `room_cleared` set WIN → `run_active=false`; `run_outcome` STAYS WIN (conditional branch
  guard: Rule 7 `if win=false AND run_outcome=NONE` does not overwrite WIN; AC-RM-07 — identified as blocking gap by qa-lead)
- `run_ended` with `run_active=false` (no active run) → `push_error` with `"[RunManager]"`; `run_active` remains `false` (AC-RM-08)

*get_run_data() API (AC-RM-09 through AC-RM-12):*
- After `run_ended`: dict contains keys `"run_active"`, `"run_outcome"`, `"waves_completed"` with finalized values (AC-RM-09)
- Mid-run read while `run_active=true` → `run_active=true`; `run_outcome=NONE` returned (AC-RM-10)
- Copy semantics: mutating the returned Dictionary does NOT affect internal fields of RunManager (AC-RM-11)
- `wave_ended` while `run_active=false` → `waves_completed` incremented AND `push_error` called (AC-RM-12)

**Integration test (AC-RM-13):**
- Full FP run sequence: `run_started` → `combat_started` → 10 `enemy_killed` signals → `run_ended(win: true)` fires
  → `get_run_data()` returns `{ run_active: false, run_outcome: WIN, waves_completed: 0 }` (AC-RM-13)

**Manual smoke check (AC-RM-14):**
- RunManager registered AFTER GameStateManager in Project Settings → AutoLoad; game starts without
  signal-connection errors in Godot output panel. Cannot be unit-tested in GUT. (AC-RM-14)

**Edge cases to cover (from GDD Edge Cases section):**
- `run_ended(false)` without any preceding `run_started`: error logged; `run_active` remains false
- FP scope: `wave_ended` never fires during a normal run (one wave, no inter-wave return) → `waves_completed=0`
  at run end is correct and expected behavior
- AutoLoad registration order wrong: `RunManager._ready()` fails to connect; `assert(GameStateManager != null)`
  guard in `_ready()` catches this

## Manual QA Checklist

### S3-11: First Playable Internal Playtest

**Verification method**: Structured developer playtest session — full run from launch to result screen
**Sign-off required**: Developer; notes written to `production/playtests/playtest-sprint3-fp-[date].md`
**Prerequisite**: S3-05, S3-07, S3-08, S3-09, and S3-10 all implemented and smoke-checked first

Checklist:
- [ ] Game launches to main menu without crash or error in output panel
- [ ] New run can be started from the main menu (no softlock; Preparation Phase loads)
- [ ] Prana Grid panel visible and editable during Preparation Phase
- [ ] Prana tokens can be placed and rearranged; confirm button responds
- [ ] Combat starts after grid confirmation: 10 enemies spawn simultaneously
- [ ] Enemy archetypes visually distinct: Drifter (steady approach), Charger (slower high-threat),
      Cluster (swarm from multiple angles)
- [ ] Cast input fires a spell and applies damage to an enemy; damage number appears on CombatHUD
- [ ] Elemental affiliation match recognized: at least one 2× damage hit observed with correct color on
      damage number (Stormgold hit on Cluster; Deepfrost hit on Charger; or Voidblue hit on Drifter)
- [ ] HP bar updates visibly when Fayde takes contact damage from an enemy
- [ ] HP zone color shifts to amber at ≤40 HP (CAREFUL) and red at ≤20 HP (DESPERATE)
- [ ] Burn or Freeze visual indicator appears on enemies after hit (at least one effect confirms tick/slow)
- [ ] Enemies die when HP reaches 0 (no zombie enemies)
- [ ] Run ends when last of 10 enemies is killed — result screen shown without softlock
- [ ] Win path: result screen allows starting a new run
- [ ] Death path: Fayde HP → 0 shows death screen without softlock; new run available
- [ ] No critical crash, softlock, or assertion error in Godot output during the session

**Fun hypothesis question** (record verdict explicitly in playtest log):
> *Does arranging the Prana grid in the Preparation Phase create a meaningful advantage in the Combat Phase?*
> *Specifically: did the pre-chosen elemental arrangement feel purposeful after seeing what enemies appeared?*

- [ ] FUN HYPOTHESIS: **CONFIRMED** — Preparation arrangement created visible strategic advantage in Combat
- [ ] FUN HYPOTHESIS: **FALSIFIED** — Combat did not reward the Preparation decision
  - If FALSIFIED: stop First Playable sign-off immediately; document what redesign is needed before next sprint

*All hard criteria from `production/milestones/first-playable.md` must be checked before S3-11 is marked COMPLETE.*

## Smoke Test Scope

Critical paths to verify before QA hand-off for Sprint 3 (run after all Must Have stories complete):

1. Game launches to main menu without crash or errors
2. New run can be started; Preparation Phase loads cleanly
3. **StatusEffects**: `apply_status(BURN)` in a live scene — visual indicator on enemy, Godot output confirms
   H&D `apply_damage` calls at 0.5s intervals; `apply_status(FREEZE)` — enemy movement visibly slowed
4. **WaveManager**: `combat_started` → verify exactly 10 enemy nodes in Godot Remote scene tree;
   `_wave_state = WAVE_ACTIVE` (inspect via debugger or print)
5. **SpellCastingEffects**: cast input fires; `apply_damage` called (damage number visible in CombatHUD);
   `cast_hit_started` signal emitted (brief movement lock on Fayde)
6. **CombatHUD**: HP bar updates on Fayde taking damage; chain indicator advances on each cast press;
   damage numbers appear over enemies
7. **RunManager**: kill all 10 enemies → result screen shown; `get_run_data()` returns `{run_outcome: WIN}`
8. **Full FP run (end-to-end)**: launch → Prep Phase → arrange grid → confirm → 10 enemies spawn →
   kill all 10 → result screen shown without softlock or crash
9. **Death path**: let Fayde die → death screen appears; new run can be started; no softlock
10. **Performance baseline**: no visible frame drops during Cluster swarm (5 Cluster enemies moving
    simultaneously); target 60fps maintained (monitor in Godot Profiler if any stutter observed)

*Run `/smoke-check sprint` once all Must Have stories are implemented and committed. Do not advance to
playtest (S3-11) until smoke check passes.*

## Playtest Requirements

| Story | Playtest Goal | Min Sessions | Target Player Type |
|-------|--------------|--------------|-------------------|
| S3-11: First Playable | Validate fun hypothesis — does Prep Phase arrangement create meaningful Combat Phase advantage? | 1 | Developer (internal) |

**Sign-off requirement**: Playtest session notes must be written to
`production/playtests/playtest-sprint3-fp-[date].md` and contain:
- Run summary (win/loss; approx enemies killed; Prana arrangement used)
- Whether the elemental affiliation bonus was recognizable without any tooltip or tutorial
- Whether the Preparation Phase arrangement felt purposeful after seeing the Combat Phase result
- Fun hypothesis verdict: **CONFIRMED** or **FALSIFIED** (must be explicit)
- If FALSIFIED: what specifically failed (randomness felt arbitrary, archetypes unreadable, etc.)

**If fun hypothesis is falsified**: Stop First Playable sign-off. Do not close the milestone. Document the
specific failure mode and redesign candidate before Sprint 4 planning. The run loop must be validated as
fun before any further Feature-layer work proceeds.

## Definition of Done — Sprint 3

A story is DONE when ALL of the following are true:

- [ ] All acceptance criteria verified — via automated test result (CI passing) OR documented manual evidence
      (screenshot/video/playtest notes with sign-off)
- [ ] Test file exists at the specified path for each Logic/Integration story:
  - `tests/unit/status-effects/status_effects_manager_test.gd` (S3-05)
  - `tests/integration/status-effects/status_effects_integration_test.gd` (S3-05)
  - `tests/integration/wave-encounter-system/wave_manager_integration_test.gd` (S3-07)
  - `tests/unit/spell-casting-effects/spell_casting_effects_test.gd` (S3-08)
  - `tests/unit/combat-hud/combat_hud_test.gd` (S3-09)
  - `tests/unit/run-management/run_manager_test.gd` (S3-10)
  - `tests/integration/run-management/run_manager_integration_test.gd` (S3-10)
- [ ] Manual evidence document exists for:
  - CombatHUD visual ACs (AC-HUD-02b, AC-HUD-24, AC-HUD-25, AC-HUD-26) — written notes in playtest log
    or dedicated evidence doc in `production/qa/evidence/`
  - SC&E physics ACs (AC-SC-07, AC-SC-09) — written verification notes
  - S3-11 playtest log in `production/playtests/`
- [ ] All GdUnit4 automated tests pass headless: `godot --headless --path . -s res://addons/gdUnit4/bin/GdUnitCmdTool.gd -a res://tests/unit --ignoreHeadlessMode` (for unit tests); swap `-a` path to `res://tests/integration` for integration tests. See `tests/gdunit4_runner.gd` for full command reference.
- [ ] No regressions in existing Sprint 1–2 tests:
  - `tests/unit/player-controller/` — all pass
  - `tests/unit/enemy-instance/` — all pass (including S3-14 fix verified headless ×5)
  - `tests/unit/health-damage/` — all pass
  - `tests/unit/prana-data/` — all pass
- [ ] Smoke check passed via `/smoke-check sprint` before playtest begins
- [ ] First Playable playtest session documented in `production/playtests/` (S3-11 gate)
- [ ] Fun hypothesis explicitly confirmed or falsified in playtest report
- [ ] Code reviewed via `/code-review` for all implementation stories (S3-05, S3-07, S3-08, S3-09, S3-10)
- [ ] Story file updated to `Status: Complete` via `/story-done` for each completed story

- S3-17 (PranaGrid) requires ADR-0013 returning SAFE — if UNSAFE, story moves to post-FP backlog with
